name: Haizakura
source:
A hardworker brimming with curiosity.

Having underwent a factory reset before coming to Kuroneko-tei, she is quite clueless when it comes to society.

Nonetheless, she is a very earnest person. Always smiling at everyone around her, she takes care of everything with full attention, and is loved by the people around her.

Sometimes she can be so carried away by her fantasies that she doesn't hear what people say.

Favorite food: Anpan
Dream: Discovering her calling
